verdict.rationale: The only local-server mechanism is exposing a local server through a public tunnel with mcp-proxy so it can be tested in the browser inspector. That is adjacent testing, not a managed remote connection. Glama's managed, gateway-fronted endpoints are documented only for servers you deploy (from the registry, a GitHub repo, or a Dockerfile/npm/PyPI artifact), so there is no evidence of bridging a local server as a managed connection without deploying it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bridge a locally running MCP server into the platform as a managed remote connection without deploying it

citations.quote: Test your local MCP servers with the inspector by exposing them via a public tunnel using mcp-proxy.
